notes.title: Update to Version 1.202
notes.content:
Update to Version 1.202


- updated the train performance charactoristics

- refined the video train speed data using new speed estimation tools.

- made changes to the signal animation system.

- Some other small fixes.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.201
notes.content:
- Further refinment of the cab relfections animation.

- Train performance charactoristics have been refined.

- Left window viewport has been improved.

- performance tweeks to improve video playback framerate.

- fixed a bug which caused the passanger information display to disapear.

- Updated the dynamic signalling system.

- Some other small fixes.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.200
notes.content:
A number of 2D assets have been updated to improve the resolution of the simulation; this will be particularly noticable on larger, widescreen monitors.

Cab inertia when accelerating and braking has been improved.

A few graphical glitches have been improved.

Some other small fixes in non- graphics related areas.
